flags.why: This expression for miscalculating is regional to Nghệ An–Hà Tĩnh and needs a Central tag ([Nghệ ngữ](https://nghengu.vn/tieng-nghe-cua-toi/lam-la-gi-1255.html)).
The adjective meaning 'perceptive' belongs to tinh ý, not tính ý ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/tinh_%C3%BD)).
flags.fix: Remove this sense from tính ý and place it under tinh ý, with the example: Chị ấy rất tinh ý nên luôn biết mọi người cần gì.

flags.why: Tòm tem refers to making sexual advances, so the gloss 'to flirt' misleadingly suggests ordinary romantic attention ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/t%C3%B2m_tem)).
Tóc sâu denotes abnormal hairs associated with itching, rather than grey or white hair generally ([Tuổi Trẻ](https://tuoitre.vn/go-o-cua-cai-ve-ve-20180115182528237.htm)).
flags.fix: coarse, unusually curly hairs associated with scalp itching
